meta.score_rule: 32 Q-head mean of z_q·z_k (own-group K), x 128^-0.5; diagnostic single selection plane (production selects per KV head)
meta.minmax_rule: Quest bound per Q-head, mean over 32 heads
meta.selection_rule: pages ranked by score, accepted only if acc + n_tok <= budget else skipped (v2: GPT-review budget fix; v1 accepted-then-checked and could exceed budget)
